products.title: KWIK-STIK™
products.description: For qualitative culture-based QC testing. An all-in-one device containing a lyophilized organism pellet, rehydration fluid and inoculating swab.

products.title: EZ-Accu Shot™
products.description: For culture media GPT. Quantitated instant dissolving organism pellets delivering 10-100 CFU with no prep and 8-hour stability. 10 tests per setup, 50 tests per kit.

products.title: Epower™
products.description: For QC of enumeration methods. Quantitated strains in CFU concentrations ranging from 10^2 to 10^8. Packaged in a glass vial containing 10 lyophilized organism pellets.

products.title: Helix Elite™
products.description: For QC of molecular instruments and assays. External, third-party molecular reference standards available in inactivated and synthetic nucleic acid ready-to-use formats.

products.title: UV-BioTAG™
products.description: Qualitative organisms containing green fluorescent protein (GFP) markers. Fluoresces under UV light to distinguish QC strains from other possible contaminants.

products.title: EZ-PEC™
products.description: For Antimicrobial Effectiveness and Preservative Efficacy Testing. Delivers a final concentration of 1.0 x 10^5 to 1.0 x 10^6 CFU per ml of the product being tested.

products.title: EZ-Accu Shot™ Select
products.description: Multi-strain kits for GPT. Includes all compendial test strains quantitated to deliver 10-100 CFU per 0.1 ml. Instant dissolve pellets, no prep and 8-hour stability.

products.title: KWIK-STIK™ Plus
products.description: Two passage qualitative reference strains. An all-in-one device containing a lyophilized organism pellet, rehydration fluid and inoculating swab.

products.title: Epower™ CRM
products.description: For ISO 17025 accredited labs. Quantitated organisms as Certified Reference Material. Available in CFU concentrations ranging from 10^2 to 10^7 per pellet.

products.title: Lab-Elite™ CRM
products.description: Certified Reference Material for ISO 17025 accredited labs. Device contains a qualitative lyophilized organism pellet, rehydration fluid and inoculating swab.

products.title: EZ-CFU™ One Step
products.description: For GPT of culture media. Quantitated organisms delivering 10-100 CFU following a quick warming step. 19 tests per setup, 190 tests per kit.

products.title: EZ-CFU™
products.description: For culture media GPT. Quantitated organisms delivering 10-100 CFU per 0.1 ml following a 1:10 dilution step. 90 tests per setup, 900+ tests per kit.

products.title: EZ-Accu Shot™ Starved Cells
products.description: For GPT of R2A Agar. Organisms are starved prior to lyophilization and quantitated to deliver 50-200 CFU/ml when rehydrated in 10 ml.

products.title: Enumerated Mycoplasma
products.description: For GPT with USP 63. Quantitated mycoplasma at 10^4 CFU/ml. Its ready-to-plate format eliminates 48 hours to 4 weeks of wait time prior to plating.

products.title: LYFO DISK™
products.description: For qualitative culture-based QC testing. Packaged in a glass vial containing 6 qualitative lyophilized organism pellets.

products.title: EZ-SPORE™
products.description: For QC of food spoilage detection methods. Quantitated spore-forming organisms at 10^4 CFU per pellet. Packaged in a glass vial containing 10 organism pellets.

products.title: QC Sets and Panels
products.description: For QC of IVD instruments and assays. Each item contains recommended QC strains for IVD platform or test method in a simple easy-to-use format.

products.title: Tri-Valent™ Swabs
products.description: For use with DNA Probe Detection Kits. Positive control swabs include whole stabilized cells of T. vaginalis, G. vaginalis, and C. albicans.

products.title: Fungal Serology
products.description: For patient culture testing. Easy-to-use Serodiagnostic Control immunodiffusion Reagents and Exoantigen Identification of Systemic Fungal Pathogens.

products.title: Microbiology Slides
products.description: For QC of microscopy. Box of ten slides containing droplets of an air-dried, fixed and preserved organism, or a smear containing a designated organism population.
